changelog: A PARITY BUILD. Everything new in 0.0.46 is desktop input work — right-button panning, the mouse wheel zooming, and a full keyboard control scheme — none of which changes anything on a phone. This build exists so Android does not sit a version behind the desktop and the Mac: it means a bug reported against "0.0.46" is the same game everywhere, which is worth more than it sounds when a report has to be reproduced on another machine. Pinch to zoom and two-finger panning are unchanged and were already here. The one fix you may actually notice: a coach tip could end up drawn behind the very panel it was describing after a long session of opening and closing menus. If you are mid-run and happy, there is nothing here you need — the next build will have Android-facing changes in it.
